class_libraries.library:
<class name="gridMapCv/InpaintFilter" type="mros::grid_map::InpaintFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Use OpenCV to inpaint/fill holes in a layer.
<class name="gridMapFilters/ThresholdFilter" type="mros::grid_map::ThresholdFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Set values below/above a threshold to a specified value.
<class name="gridMapFilters/MinInRadiusFilter" type="mros::grid_map::MinInRadiusFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute for each cell of a layer the minimal value inside a radius.
<class name="gridMapFilters/MeanInRadiusFilter" type="mros::grid_map::MeanInRadiusFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute for each cell of a layer the mean value inside a radius.
<class name="gridMapFilters/MedianFillFilter" type="mros::grid_map::MedianFillFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Fill holes (NaNs) in a layer using the median value inside a radius. Optionally, apply median calculations for values that are already finite.
<class name="gridMapFilters/MockFilter" type="mros::grid_map::MockFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Does Identity, but allows to set a delay and debug prints. Used for testing purposes.
<class name="gridMapFilters/NormalVectorsFilter" type="mros::grid_map::NormalVectorsFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute the normal vectors of a layer in a map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/CurvatureFilter" type="mros::grid_map::CurvatureFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute the curvature (second derivative) of a layer in the map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/NormalColorMapFilter" type="mros::grid_map::NormalColorMapFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute a new color layer based on normal vectors layers.
<class name="gridMapFilters/LightIntensityFilter" type="mros::grid_map::LightIntensityFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Compute the diffuse lighting of a surface as new black and white color layer.
<class name="gridMapFilters/MathExpressionFilter" type="mros::grid_map::MathExpressionFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Parse and evaluate a mathematical matrix expression with layers of a grid map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/SlidingWindowMathExpressionFilter" type="mros::grid_map::SlidingWindowMathExpressionFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Parse and evaluate a mathematical matrix expression within a sliding window on a layer of a grid map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/DuplicationFilter" type="mros::grid_map::DuplicationFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Duplicate a layer of a grid map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/DeletionFilter" type="mros::grid_map::DeletionFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Delete layers from a grid map.
<class name="gridMapFilters/ColorFillFilter" type="mros::grid_map::ColorFillFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Creates a new color layer.
<class name="gridMapFilters/ColorMapFilter" type="mros::grid_map::ColorMapFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Creates a new color layer with the color mapped between min. and max. value.
<class name="gridMapFilters/ColorBlendingFilter" type="mros::grid_map::ColorBlendingFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Blend two color layers.
<class name="gridMapFilters/SetBasicLayersFilter" type="mros::grid_map::SetBasicLayersFilter" base_class_type="mros::filters::FilterBase" >
Set specified layers of a grid map as basic layers.

Normalizes the buffer of a map such that it has default (zero) start index.
